notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
The version 1.1 of Party Saboteurs: After Party is here and it brings:
[list]
[*] 1 new stage based on the Indie Warehouse, the space of coworking oriented to game development, located here in Brasilia and where we work.
[*] 5 new characters. One of them is the Ranger Chroma Red from the game Choroma Squad of our friends from Behold Studios.
[*] 1 New gadget
[/list]

To unlock the content find the yellow boxes in the stages and shoot them. Hope you all enjoy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22950851/2fd26ac0eeb808a1aa1cf97bc0916d0cebe9e2c4.png[/img]

Alexandre Haru  - Seize Studios

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Party Saboteurs: After Party will receive an update this week.

This patch will bring some more new content and corrections. The details will be revealed in the next days.

notes.title: Announcement - Party Saboteurs: After Party
notes.content:
Ladies and gentlemen,

We are very happy to inform that a new version of Party Saboteurs is coming on September 1rst and it'll be called Party Saboteurs: After Party.

If you already bought the game in the past, it will be a FREE UPDATE.


Two years ago when Party Saboteurs fist launched we were unable by contract to keep working on the game, but we knew that the game needed more attention to reach its full potential. So we made a partnership with a friend Studio, the guys of Seize Studios and they assumed our affection to Party and developed all this new content.

For all of you that liked our game and it's distinct mechanic, for all of you that had fun with friends and for all of your complaints we are bring a
 new version of our game, and it brings.

- A story mode with a single player campaign
- New Characters
- New Scenarios
- New Gadgets
- Improvements and bug corrections

We know that some of you gave up on waiting for this updates. We are sorry for taking so long, but they are here and we hope you enjoy.

 We really believe in Party Saboteurs as a game that can make people have a great time with friends  in the most pure way that games are capable to do that. And that's why we never forgot the game.

Follow our friends of Seize Studios on Instagram for more content of Party Saboteurs. They are putting a lot of love on it. instagram.com/seizestudiosgames

THE PARTY IS NOT OVER

Glitch Factory

notes.title: New Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
What’s up, Saboteurs?

Hello everyone, first of all, we’d like to apologize for being so absent from the community and not releasing regular updates. This is going to change in the next weeks.

At the time we released Party Saboteurs in early-access here, we had the opportunity to receive some investment in our 5-man company, but to get the money we would have to start a new project.

Being a really small team it was kind of hard to work in our next huge project while working in PS at the same time,  we managed to pull a lot of work during some time, but it kept getting harder and harder to keep working on both projects at the same time. Then we got to the point of not working at all with our favorite spies.

Recently we released the trailer for our next project and now we have a lot of time in our hands to finish what we planned for Party Saboteurs, and by that we mean:

[list]

[*] Lots of new gadgets;
[*] New interface;
[*] New parties;
[*] New spies;
[*] Game Highlights;
[*] Coolest of all: a Twitch Mode.

[/list]

This new system will work this way: the player will be able to stream his game through Twitch and the viewers will be able to interact in-game with the player, viewers will be able to kill the player by controlling a Twitch Sniper.

We're running some tests right now. When we get to the point of setting a date to this next update we hope to count with your help to check the results.

Thank you all!
Best regards,
Glitch Team.
